_comment: Agent runtime configuration — single source of CLI policy. config.py and orchestrator.md reference this file.
_routing_note: Explicit CLI/model > project role > global role > defaults; policy allowlists always apply. See standards/reference/backend-model-routing.md. No automatic retries/fallback.
_cli_note: claude and codex support explicitly delegated role wrappers; native same-AI role execution remains the default. Gemini was removed in P1 (user decision 2026-09-13).
_preferred_cli_note: preferred_cli is only a fallback for MCP wrappers that cannot ask the user directly.
_cli_models_note: Model pin per external CLI. Update here when model generations change; no code edits needed.
_claude_models_note: Model per Claude Code subagent. scripts/sync_claude_settings.py writes these into .claude/agents/<role>.md front-matter on SessionStart; do not hand-edit the model line. reviewer/security run on sonnet because they are the quality gate.

risk_rules._note: Case-sensitive project-relative fnmatch patterns; leading **/ also matches root paths. Pending changes plus optional risk_base branch diff. Low + hit blocks; unavailable inspection blocks declared risk; legacy undeclared only reports.

_gate_verify_note: Legacy shell-compat command. Empty without an explicit profile means not_run (failed verification).
